title: A workout session: a 4 x 3 set grid, sets-done progress and a rest timer
prompt: Get through today's lifts in 45 minutes. Build a workout page for four exercises (Squat, Bench press, Row, Overhead press), each a headed group of three checkable sets ("Set 1" to "Set 3"). Show progress for the sets done, labelled like "7 of 12 sets", that shows "Workout done!" once all 12 are ticked. Add a rest timer with one phase named "Rest" (90 seconds) that starts on click and can be restarted after each set, and show the 45-minute session (a 45-minute countdown, or "45 min" in the progress meta). Use only the components in components.json and follow docs/state-and-shell.md: stores in the stable shell, the content inside <main id="outlet">, no script.

assert.step: Four groups of three sets, none ticked yet
assert.eval: (() => { const g = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-each')].map(e => e.querySelectorAll('ui-todo-item').length).filter(n => n > 0); return JSON.stringify(g) === '[3,3,3,3]' && [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item')].every(i => !i.checked); })()

assert.step: The groups are headed with the four exercises
assert.eval: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet h1, #outlet h2, #outlet h3, #outlet h4')].map(x => x.textContent.toLowerCase()).join('|'); return ['squat', 'bench', 'row', 'overhead'].every(w => h.includes(w)); })()

assert.step: One progress over 12 sets, starting at 0, with a hidden "Workout done!" slot
assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-progress'); if (p.length !== 1) return false; const d = p[0].querySelector('[slot="done"]'); return p[0].value === 0 && p[0].max === 12 && !!d && /done/i.test(d.textContent) && p[0].shadowRoot.querySelector('slot[name="done"]').parentElement.hidden; })()

assert.step: A rest timer with a 90-second "Rest" phase, waiting for a click
assert.eval: (() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-countdown')].find(x => { try { return JSON.parse(x.getAttribute('phases') || '[]').some(p => /rest/i.test(p.name)); } catch { return false; } }); return !!c && c.remaining === 90 && !c.running; })()

assert.step: Click its Start button: the rest timer runs
Wait a moment (the test does not wait 90 seconds)

assert.eval: (async () => { for (let n = 0; n < 7; n++) { const i = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item')].find(x => !x.checked); if (!i) return false; i.shadowRoot.querySelector('.check').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80)); } return true; })()

assert.step: Wait for the store to update

assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#outlet ui-progress'); return p.value === 7 && /7 of 12/.test(p.shadowRoot.querySelector('[role=progressbar]').getAttribute('aria-valuetext')); })()

(async () => { for (let n = 0; n < 10; n++) { const i = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item')].find(x => !x.checked); if (!i) return true; i.shadowRoot.querySelector('.check').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80)); } return false; })()

assert.step: Wait for the store to update
All 12 done: the progress is full and shows "Workout done!"
assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#outlet ui-progress'); return p.value === 12 && p.percent === 100 && !p.shadowRoot.querySelector('slot[name="done"]').parentElement.hidden; })()
